title: Oscar-winning actress Eva Marie Saint dies at 102
title_zh: 奥斯卡影后伊娃·玛丽·圣去世，享年102岁
lead: Eva Marie Saint, the Oscar-winning actress who starred in On the Waterfront and North by Northwest, has died at 102. Her family confirmed she passed away peacefully at her Los Angeles home.
lead_zh: 奥斯卡影后伊娃·玛丽·圣去世，享年102岁。她曾主演《码头风云》和《西北偏北》。家人证实她在洛杉矶家中安详离世。

preview_zh: 奥斯卡影后伊娃·玛丽·圣去世，享年102岁。她曾主演《码头风云》和《西北偏北》等好莱坞经典影片。她的家庭代表杰夫·桑德森证实，她于周二在洛杉矶家中因自然原因安详离世，家人和亲友陪伴在侧。
paragraphs: Eva Marie Saint, the Oscar-winning actress who starred in Hollywood classics such as On the Waterfront and North by Northwest, has died aged 102. She passed away on Tuesday of natural causes at her home in Los Angeles, surrounded by family and loved ones, her family representative Jeff Sanderson confirmed.

Saint won the Academy Award for best supporting actress for her movie debut in Elia Kazan's 1954 crime drama On the Waterfront, playing Edie Doyle, the film's moral compass and the love interest of Marlon Brando's conflicted boxer-turned-docker. Five years later, she portrayed femme fatale Eve Kendall, dangerously seducing Cary Grant's entangled advertising executive in Alfred Hitchcock's spy thriller North by Northwest.

Until her death, Saint was the oldest surviving Oscar winner and one of the last remaining stars of Hollywood's golden age. Starting her career in live television in the late 1940s, she also won an Emmy Award in 1990 for her role as the rich widow Lil Van Degan Altemus in People Like Us.

Born in Newark, New Jersey in 1924, Saint had originally intended to become a teacher before developing a passion for theatre. She trained in New York at the Herbert Berghof Studio and then the Actors Studio, the home of method acting co-founded by Kazan. She burst onto the Hollywood scene with her performance as the gentle but resolute Edie in Kazan's classic.

Saint's co-star Brando was an intense method actor and she admitted to having found him "adorable" but "a little frightening". "I felt that he could see right through me," she told Turner Classic Movies in a 2013 interview. Accepting her Oscar while nine months pregnant, she quipped: "I may have the baby right here!" She wasn't far off, having her son just two days afterwards.

She was considered a surprise choice to play one of Hitchcock's cool and calculating heroines in his masterpiece North by Northwest. The English filmmaker was known for being very demanding of his leading ladies. "He worked with me from the outside in," said Saint. "My hair, my makeup, my shoes, my jewellery, my purse, my gloves, everything. And just from creating that exterior for me, he gave me the sense of a spy lady." Critics have argued that her character helped to create the sophisticated, sexually confident and intelligent blonde-haired archetype that many "Bond women" later followed in the 007 films.

Saint also starred opposite Paul Newman in Otto Preminger's Exodus in 1960, and alongside Warren Beatty in John Frankenheimer's All Fall Down. But she then scaled back her career while raising a family with her husband, director Jeffrey Hayden. Half a century later, Saint made a big screen comeback as Clark Kent's adoptive mother in the 2006 blockbuster Superman Returns, while in her 80s. And she later had parts in the supernatural fantasy Winter's Tale, alongside Colin Farrell and Russell Crowe, and the 2019 nun drama Mariette in Ecstasy. This all followed her Emmy win in 1990 for her role in the TV miniseries People Like Us, which was set among New York's high society.

Saint, who has two stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame for her movie and TV work, said her longevity in acting had given her work extra depth. "The longer you live, the smarter you get, because you've been around, you've seen things," she told TCM. "You've gone through different emotional experiences in your own life, and hopefully, you understand things better. And that makes you a better actress." Saint's marriage to Hayden lasted for 65 years, until his death in 2016, and she is survived by their two children.
paragraphs_zh: 奥斯卡影后伊娃·玛丽·圣去世，享年102岁。她曾主演《码头风云》和《西北偏北》等好莱坞经典影片。她的家庭代表杰夫·桑德森证实，她于周二在洛杉矶家中因自然原因安详离世，家人和亲友陪伴在侧。
圣凭借在伊利亚·卡赞1954年犯罪剧情片《码头风云》中的电影首秀获得奥斯卡最佳女配角奖，饰演伊迪·多伊尔——影片的道德指南针，也是马龙·白兰度饰演的内心矛盾的拳击手转码头工人的爱慕对象。五年后，她在阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克的间谍惊悚片《西北偏北》中饰演蛇蝎美人伊芙·肯德尔，危险地引诱加里·格兰特饰演的陷入困境的广告主管。
直到去世前，圣是最年长的在世奥斯卡奖得主，也是好莱坞黄金时代最后一批明星之一。她于1940年代末开始从事电视直播工作，并因在《像我们这样的人》中饰演富有的寡妇莉尔·范·德根·阿尔特默斯而于1990年获得艾美奖。
圣1924年出生于新泽西州纽瓦克，最初打算成为一名教师，后来对戏剧产生了热情。她在纽约的赫伯特·伯格霍夫工作室接受培训，随后进入由卡赞联合创立的 method acting 大本营演员工作室。她凭借在卡赞经典作品中饰演温柔而坚定的伊迪而一举闯入好莱坞。
圣的搭档白兰度是一位 intense method actor，她承认觉得他“可爱”但“有点吓人”。“我觉得他能看穿我，”她在2013年接受特纳经典电影频道采访时说。挺着九个月身孕接受奥斯卡奖时，她打趣道：“我可能就在这里生孩子了！”她差一点就说中了，两天后她就生下了儿子。

在希区柯克的杰作《西北偏北》中，她被选中饰演他笔下冷静而精于算计的女主角之一，这被认为是一个出人意料的选择。这位英国导演以对女主角要求严苛而闻名。“他从外到内地塑造我，”圣说。“我的头发、我的妆容、我的鞋子、我的珠宝、我的手袋、我的手套，一切。仅仅通过为我创造那个外表，他就给了我一种间谍女郎的感觉。”评论家认为，她的角色帮助创造了那种精致、性感自信且聪明的金发女性原型，后来许多“邦女郎”在007电影中纷纷效仿。

圣还曾与保罗·纽曼联袂出演奥托·普雷明格1960年的《出埃及记》，并与沃伦·比蒂合作出演约翰·弗兰肯海默的《情场浪子》。但随后她为了与丈夫、导演杰弗里·海登组建家庭而减少了演艺工作。半个世纪后，圣在80多岁时凭借2006年大片《超人归来》中克拉克·肯特的养母一角重返大银幕。后来她还在与科林·法瑞尔和罗素·克劳合作的超自然奇幻片《冬日奇缘》以及2019年的修女题材剧情片《狂喜中的玛丽埃特》中出演角色。这一切都发生在她在1990年因在电视迷你剧《像我们这样的人》中的角色获得艾美奖之后，该剧以纽约上流社会为背景。
圣在好莱坞星光大道上因电影和电视作品拥有两颗星，她说自己在演艺界的 longevity 赋予了她的作品额外的深度。“你活得越久，就越聪明，因为你见多识广，经历过事情，”她告诉TCM。“你在自己的生活中经历了不同的情感体验，但愿你能更好地理解事物。而这会让你成为更好的女演员。”圣与海登的婚姻持续了65年，直到他于2016年去世，她身后留下他们的两个孩子。
